$comment: eApps R3 (docs/spec/apps.md §3.4, §9): the per-kind record policy and the member's app access, ONE rule for every host: the TS reference (src/host/record-policy.ts) and the Rust core (eui_core::host::record_policy) replay it, the Exponential server enforces it (the records service on every read and write, the app-records shape's row filter for `read`), and the four clients use it to disable what the server would refuse and for the editor's "Run as <member>" preview. A kind's `policy` (package formatVersion 3) names a LEVEL per OP: `member` = any member of the app's team, `author` = the record's author (`authorId ?? createdBy`; a row with neither has no author) or a team owner, `owners` = team owners only (not even the author). `create` is member or owners (a new record has no author yet). An op the policy leaves out keeps `defaults`; an invalid entry keeps its default too (validation reports it: `validateCases`, issue paths under the kind's `/policy`; `effective` = the policy hosts apply). Over it sits the member's `app_access` LEVEL for the app (`access`): `none` = nothing at all (the app is hidden from the Apps list and syncs no records), `read` = reads only (writes refused, inputs disabled), `write` = everything the policy allows (no row = write); it binds owners too. `allowCases`: `refusal` = why the viewer may not (the exact `copy` text: a toast, a disabled control's reason, the server's FORBIDDEN), null = allowed. Order: signed out (`viewer` null), not a member of the team (`role` null) or access none = `copy.none`; access read and a write = `copy.readOnly`; a team owner = allowed; the op's level (`copy.author[op]`, `copy.owners[op]`). `readable`: the rows a viewer may read, each by its kind's policy (an undeclared kind = the defaults), in row order.

copy.none: You have no access to this app
copy.readOnly: You have read-only access to this app

author.read: Only the record's author or a team owner can read it
author.update: Only the record's author or a team owner can change it
author.delete: Only the record's author or a team owner can change it

owners.read: Only team owners can read these records
owners.create: Only team owners can add these records
owners.update: Only team owners can change these records
owners.delete: Only team owners can change these records
